title: Check current authority before replaying scoped work
summary: A replay receipt, live session row, or expired lease is historical evidence. Recompute current authority or preserve unresolved effect ownership before permitting another operation.
reusable_steps: A replay receipt, live session row, or expired lease is historical evidence
Recompute current authority or preserve unresolved effect ownership before permitting another operation
expected_outcome: For durable scoped work, keep source identity and operation identity in the persisted record. For read-side revalidation, check current provenance and verified grant state before returning active access. At a tenant-cleared audit boundary, retain caller attribution as metadata while clearing inherited entity bindings. For external effects, retain the original target and attempt across lease expiry until completion or governed reconciliation. Verify boundary cases with multi-instance and legacy-data tests on the current base.
